title: Composite Report Parts: seed via a report extension instead of install/upgrade code
summary: The 14 shipped header/footer designs and report themes are now registered through a declarative Composite Layout report extension on Tenant Report Defaults instead of install/upgrade seeding code. The seeding codeunits, upgrade tag and SeedPart tests were removed, which also removes the elevated write path.
key_points: Report extension replaces SeedPart-based install/upgrade code for seeding header/footer designs and themes
Removes Composite Report Parts Mgt. codeunit, upgrade logic, and associated test suite
Report part resources moved from .resources to Foundation/Reporting directory
Platform now owns registering report extension layouts natively
Eliminates permission-elevation issues from the previous approach
